description: Send expense and income drafts to your doorledge inbox, with optional receipt or invoice files. Review each item in the doorledge iPhone app before saving it. The connection can list property names you choose to share and check drafts submitted through this assistant. It cannot read, change or delete your saved ledger, team information or exports, make payments, or provide tax advice. Requires a doorledge account, active subscription, and the inbox-enabled iPhone update, currently in TestFlight.
